integrity: The universal claim has a written proof and an executable finite exact-arithmetic checker. Its independent mathematical audit and independent priority validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns standard-Euclidean diameters only for ordinal sums of two antichains with lower size at least 1 and upper size at least 2. No general preorder, other metric, or graph-diameter assertion is made; priority comparison is nonexhaustive.
title: Exact Euclidean diameters and diametral pairs of two-level preorder polytopes
